From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake & portal upload — OneTrust mapping notes

Monica / team —

Technical notes for OneTrust bulk import (from last integration):
- OneTrust expects a CSV with exact header names: DocumentName, DocumentType, ControlID, UploadChecksum, FileSizeBytes. If header names differ we need to map them during import; mapping increases manual review time.
- PDF flattening: remove embedded attachments (some SIG responses reference zipped logs). Those should be added as separate files and referenced in the CSV as DocumentName = logs/XXX.zip. OneTrust will not parse attachments embedded inside PDFs.
- Bookmarks and internal links are permitted but some older OneTrust parsers interpret bookmarks as separate documents; to avoid issues we recommend removing bookmarks.
- Filename conventions: lowercase, hyphens, no spaces, max 120 chars. Example: sig-acme-answers-20270510.pdf
- Checksum we use: SHA256 hex string. I'll include a checksum column in the final CSV.

I've attached a small script we use to flatten and checksum PDFs (script stub + instructions) and a sample mapped CSV. Also flagging that Whistic's portal allows direct PDF + attachments in a single upload but OneTrust requires explicit CSV rows per file — double-check which portal Brynn's team will use.

Marissa Cole
Security Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): ot-flatten-script.sh (script stub), sample-onetrust-csv.csv
